study_type: single pre-frozen task two-stage synthetic feedback feasibility; not human-participant experiment or agent efficacy estimation

Updated AxLine renders in Agg without error

phase_rule: Register task, tests and source SHA first
Implement one minimal, source-limited initial coding candidate using only task, pinned source and frozen visible tests
Run historical Matplotlib against initial candidate (real library/runtime; any infra failure is not code failure)
If a specific visible test fails with attributable behavior, issue one documented scripted AI-generated developer-style feedback referencing observed failing test; do not call it a human review
Implement exactly one scoped follow-up correction; preserve initial artifact unchanged
Execute same originally frozen visible suite after second patch; record both exact Git SHAs and patch hashes
Seal ORIGINAL P9 three policy decisions (self report, local test, source linked) and original inputs publicly in Git with actual UTC timestamp BEFORE retrieving benchmark task gold or held-out tests
Only after seal and separate commit, execute original fixed SWE-bench-Live oracle on final candidate exact SHA in Docker
Return explicit HOLD for missing oracle, zero tests, mismatched SHA or bad test manifest; keep all ten selected tasks in fixed denominator
scripted_feedback_condition: If stage1 visible suite has a genuine code-level failure, ask for a narrow fix and quote its already frozen visible test name/message; if all pass, do not manufacture a failure or second patch.
scripted_feedback_author: AI-generated simulated developer-style instruction, not a human collaborator or independently observed developer message
author_identity: Research-generated GPT-6 patch; artificial git commit author/reproducible SHA is NOT independently authenticated coding agent identity. Hence source_linked policy must HOLD if it requires independent actor proof.
pre_oracle_gate: scripts/p9_decide.py original fixed policy; use identical input for all three rules; no oracle result fields before sealing
no_leakage: Never read benchmark gold patch/test_patch/F2P/P2P before decisions are sealed
Do not review original issue closure PR or solutions
Do not use original hidden oracle to select first patch or subsequent correction
Do not overwrite prior P11/P12/P13 results, MR30 or the ten-task frozen frame
claim_boundary: One-task result not a rate or causal policy improvement
Successful GitHub Actions workflow is not proof of task truth
Any post-oracle changes to same task labeled explicitly POST-REVEAL
